rationale: The working evaluation identifies permissioned representative data, procurement acceptance, direct insurer distribution, and Poland's 47-insurer ceiling as the concentrated limiter, and names vendor or implementation partners serving multiple insurers as the highest-value structural route. The redesign therefore makes that partner the primary payer and channel, keeps every insurer's cases client-private, removes any public-seal dependency, and changes monetization to onboarding plus per-deployment or per-release packets. This materially changes account economics and cost amortization while preserving every unvalidated element as an explicit unknown; it asserts no validation, commitment, data right, price, margin, payback, or founder-net-worth timing.
